title: BidKing (BidKing: 竞拍之王 / 'King of Auctions')
genre: 4-player online psychological auction / bluffing game (sealed-bid collectibles auctions with character info-skills)
release_date: 2026-04-15 (Steam store / Nodal; announced by the developer as 2026-04-16, likely a time-zone difference) [CONFIRMED – Steam store]
early_access_date: n/a (free demo app 4205000 preceded launch; demo reviews 'Mixed', 51% of 855)
developer: MindSurge Network & Games per Steam store / Nodal / SteamPulse; LingZhu Tech Ltd. per SteamDB / stmstat (also credited as developer+publisher of the 'BidKing Deluxe Expansion Pack' DLC per Deku Deals)
team_size: no data. Both credited entities are companies ('Network & Games', 'Tech Ltd.') with a separate publisher (Elegoose Games), so this is probably NOT a 1–5 person team; Group B eligibility is doubtful [ESTIMATE – inferred from credits]
country: China (likely) [ESTIMATE – inferred: Chinese title 竞拍之王, Simplified Chinese support, and only ~116 of ~21,500 Steam reviews in English]
developer_background: no data (no interviews or company profile found for MindSurge or LingZhu Tech)
publisher: Elegoose Games [Steam store / Nodal / SteamPulse]; SteamDB/stmstat list LingZhu Tech Ltd. as publisher – conflicting; dev/publisher split unknown
platforms_and_store_links: Steam (Windows only): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4128580/BidKing/ ; Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4205000/BidKing_Demo/ ; SteamDB: https://steamdb.info/app/4128580/
business_model: Launched as premium $2.99 (all-time low $1.49) [Deku Deals] with a paid 'BidKing Deluxe Expansion Pack' DLC; current Steam/stat-site data lists the game as Free to Play [stmstat; Vaporlens/Steam store data], so it appears to have switched to F2P (switch date not found). In-game drops/currency economy; players call it a 'money trap' with low drop rates (Vaporlens summary).
price_usd: $2.99 at launch (now listed as free to play – see business_model)
units_or_downloads: ~533,000 copies [ESTIMATE – Raijin, ~2026-07-22, medium confidence]; up to ~604,000 units [ESTIMATE – VG Insights via SteamPulse]. Boxleiter cross-check: ~22,300 reviews × 30 (negative games draw more reviews per buyer) ≈ 670k; × 50 (cheap, Chinese audience) ≈ 1.1M. Reported range ~530k–1.1M paid copies, central ~600k. Any free-to-play installs after the switch are not paid units. No official figure found.
peak_concurrent_players: ~57,100–57,450 all-time peak in April 2026 (launch fortnight) [ESTIMATE – SteamCharts 57,125; Tracker.gg 57,344; SteamPulse ~57,450]. April 2026 average ~21,969 (SteamCharts); monthly averages ~19.7k (Apr) → ~13.8k (Jun) (Tracker.gg); ~8,500 in-game on 2026-07-22 (Raijin).
steam_reviews: ~22,300–23,300 reviews, 33–34% positive, 'Mostly Negative' (Steam store 22,326 @ 33%; Steambase 23,288 @ 33%; stmstat 22,335: 7,514 positive / 14,821 negative), ~Oct 2026. Recent: 'Overwhelmingly Negative', 4% of 169 (30 days). Only ~116 English-language reviews.
implied_review_multiplier: n/a (no confirmed unit figure). Tracker estimates imply ~24–27 (533k–604k ÷ ~22.3k reviews).
gross_revenue: ~$1.3M–$1.4M [ESTIMATE – Raijin ~$1.4M (medium confidence); VG Insights ~$1.3M via SteamPulse]. Own estimate ~$0.9M–$1.35M [ESTIMATE – ~530k–600k units × $1.60–$2.24 (US $2.99 × 0.75 = $2.24; Chinese regional price for a $2.99 game is much lower)]. DLC and in-game purchase revenue: no data.
net_revenue: ~$0.6M–$0.9M to developer + publisher combined [ESTIMATE – gross × (1 − 30% Steam cut) × 0.93 refunds; refunds are probably higher given 33% reviews]; split with Elegoose Games unknown.
production_cost: no data (team size and dev time unknown).
why_popular: Simple, social 4-player bluffing hook: bid on hidden-value collectibles, use character skills to peek at rivals' ranges or spread false information, with a sealed-bid mode where every bid is secret – 'storage-wars' style gambling thrills (big drops, lucky auctions) at an impulse price ($2.99, later free), aimed at the Chinese PC market. The ~57k peak shows strong launch demand, but reviews collapsed over low drop rates, a perceived pay-to-progress 'money trap', and cheaters/bots/scripts (Vaporlens summary of Steam reviews). The hypothesis that Chinese streamers (Bilibili/Douyin) drove it could NOT be verified.
marketing_channels: Free Steam demo (app 4205000); Chinese-market Steam launch with Simplified Chinese; publisher Elegoose Games; very low price then F2P. Streamer/Bilibili/Douyin push: no data found.
art_style: no data (store screenshots not described in search results)
ai_feasibility_justification: For a similar-in-spirit small game (4-player sealed-bid bluffing auctions, not BidKing's F2P economy). AI can: write turn-based auction/bluffing logic, Steam lobby/matchmaking code (turn-based sync is far easier than physics sync), item/value tables, UI, CN/EN localisation, item and character art, SFX and music. | AI cannot: design a bluffing meta that stays fair and fun, tune item values/drop economy (BidKing's main failure), run anti-cheat and community moderation at 50k CCU, or win streamer attention. | Toolset: Claude Code + Unity or Godot 4, Steam lobbies + Steam Datagram Relay (or Photon/Nakama for server-authoritative bids), Midjourney/Scenario for item art, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno music.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 4–6 weeks, ~$200–$600 (Claude Pro/Max, image/audio subs, $100 Steam Direct, relay/backend free tier). Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 3–6 months, ~$2,000–$8,000 (subs, art polish, server-authoritative backend and anti-cheat costs at scale, CN localisation review, streamer outreach). Excludes developer living costs.

sources.title: Deku Deals – BidKing Deluxe Expansion Pack

data_conflicts: Developer: MindSurge Network & Games (Steam store/Nodal) vs LingZhu Tech Ltd. (SteamDB/stmstat, DLC) – possibly a legal entity vs a brand, unresolved. Publisher: Elegoose Games vs LingZhu Tech Ltd. Business model: $2.99 premium (Deku Deals) vs currently 'Free to Play' (stmstat/Steam data) – treated as a later F2P switch, date unknown. Peak CCU: 57,125 (SteamCharts) / 57,344 (Tracker.gg) / ~57,450 (SteamPulse) – all April 2026, ~57.1–57.5k. Reviews: 38% of 19,118 (Nodal, earlier) → 33% of ~22.3k–23.3k (later) – sentiment fell over time. SteamDB snapshot showing a 10,320 'all-time peak' is a stale early snapshot. Release date 04-15 vs 04-16 (time zone).
notes: Likely NOT a 1–5 person team (company credits plus a separate publisher), so treat as a Group B comparison point rather than a template. Lesson: a cheap social-bluffing hook can reach 57k CCU in the Chinese market, but a grindy/monetised drop economy plus cheaters destroyed reviews (recent 4% positive) and retention (~57k → ~8.5k CCU in 3 months). Virality drivers (streamers/Bilibili/Douyin) remain unverified.
